about_the_game:
The Goal of Sef Saga is to allow you to have many different choices from the start of the game. It is a project that is still being worked on by one developer.

Sef Saga invites you to a truly open-ended roleplaying experience, a sandbox game where your destiny is yours to command. No two playthroughs are alike, thanks to a randomized world that guarantees fresh adventures every time, the life in this world is alive and creates a nice ecobalance for you to enjoy. With 14 diverse skills to hone all the way to level 50.

you'll have ample opportunities to customize your character and playstyle. An innovative talking system allows for deep interaction with in-game entities, opening up a wealth of errands, quests, and narrative possibilities.

Your adventures aren't limited to the surface; explore the depths by digging down, reaching the fiery realm of Magamada after two descents. Keep an eye out for the enigmatic Labyrinths that mysteriously appear in the desert, promising untold treasures to those brave enough to explore them. Embrace the life of a fierce Hunter, a peaceful farmer, or a cunning master trader – the path you choose is entirely up to you. This ongoing project is designed to offer unparalleled freedom and choice from the very beginning.

The road is yours.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3 12100f
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Iris XE graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 Home
  • Processor: 11 Gen Intel i5 1135G7 2.4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Iris XE graphics

short_description: Shape your unique adventure in Sef Saga, a roleplaying sandbox, every game is different! Master 14 skills, talk to anyone, and forge your path. Explore above ground, delve to Magamada, or hunt for treasure in desert Labyrinths. Be a combatant, a farmer, or a trader and more – your destiny awaits.
